verdict.rationale: Bevy is documented as "just a normal Rust dependency" that can be added to an existing project, and a runtime probe confirms it resolves on the crates.io registry, so the library-from-a-registry model holds. However, that registry and toolchain are Rust/Cargo, not a web developer's npm/bundler pipeline. Web output appears only as WASM-compiled examples, not as an importable JS package. Missing for 10: distribution via a web package registry (e.g. npm), integration with JS bundlers, evidence of tree-shaking or dead-code elimination, documented WASM build workflow into an existing web project.
